start: Same share sheet; a friend also uses MettleUp

steps.action: On the friend's phone: Workout → Routines → 'Import a routine file' ('A file another MettleUp member shared') and pick the file
user_sees: 'Routines added'
'They are in a new folder on the Workout tab.' or 'New in your library: <exercises>.'
must_not: The friend's own routines changed
The sender's exercises marked as the friend's history

steps.action: Pick a photo from the gallery
user_sees: 'Could not open that file'
'That file is too big to be a routine file.' or 'That file is not a routine file.'
must_not: The app freezing while it reads a large video
A folder made from the photo

user_sees: 'That file comes from a newer MettleUp. Update the app, then try again.'
must_not: A half-read folder

user_sees: 'That file has no routines in it.'
must_not: An empty folder saved

steps.action: On a phone with no app to send with, tap 'Send as a file'
user_sees: 'Sharing is not available'
'This phone has no app to send the file with.'
must_not: A crash

start: A routine file already imported once into the folder 'Jaipur'; the member since changed 'Push 1'

steps.action: Import the same file again

must_not: A second folder made without asking

steps.action: Tap 'Update the existing folder'
user_sees: 'Folder updated'
'Your changes were kept in: Push 1.' or 'You had this file already, so its folder was updated.'
must_not: The member's own changes to Push 1 lost

steps.action: Import it again and close the sheet without choosing
user_sees: Nothing changed
must_not: A copy or an update made anyway

steps.action: Tap 'Send as a file'

must_not: Workout history, body weight or photos in the file
